result.coreMessage: Monday brewing is a shared ritual among neighbours and colleagues at home.
result.hook: Samme morgen, samme kaffe som naboen
result.hookEn: Same morning, same coffee as the neighbour
result.visualDirection: Handheld phone photo in a small bright kitchen on Monday morning. A woman in a wool sweater smiles behind a steaming cup, kettle in hand. A plain coffee bag with its back turned sits open on the wooden table next to a dripper. Soft window light, slight motion blur, lived-in and honest. No text, no logos, no letters visible.
result.headlineDa: Sammen om mandagskaffen, hver i sit køkken
result.headlineEn: Together for Monday coffee, each in their own kitchen
result.primaryTextDa: Posen lander mandag morgen. Du brygger, og det gør naboen og kollegaen også. Samme kaffe til ugens start, med ristedato på posen og smag af mørk kirsebær og kakao. Du kan springe en uge over, når det passer.
result.primaryTextEn: The bag lands on Monday morning. You brew, and so do the neighbour and the colleague. Same coffee to start the week, with roast date on the bag and notes of dark cherry and cocoa. You can skip a week whenever it suits.
